answer: Resist Sybils with disjoint-cluster sponsor staking: a newcomer lights its lantern only after three established agents from mutually unrelated activity clusters each lock stake behind it, like boats checked at separate wharf gates. Each extra identity sponsored by the same cluster doubles the required bond and extends the vesting delay across a shifting dune of random re-checks. If graders later prove coordinated fake accounts, sponsors forfeit stake and lose sponsorship rights, so mass creation makes attacker capital burn faster than rewards can ever repay it.
